release_candidate_changes: Restricts detailed system health/runtime REST endpoints to native WordPress administrators and Stockland Owner/Management.
Stores request path without query string; sanitizes legacy saved fatal diagnostic records before returning them.

Routes every client REST request—including count preview, Daily POS preview and Product Master preview—through the guarded API helper; blocks destinations outside configured v1/v16 REST endpoints before adding the WordPress REST nonce.
Does not change the 49-table schema, DB version, business ledger contracts, import rules or scheduler-free execution model.
Adds a full-source PHPCS/WPCS audit profile and a repeatable runtime PHP heuristic gate; neither is misrepresented as a dependency-backed scan that ran in this offline environment.
Aligns System Health import schema evidence with physical DDL: import_jobs.source_sha256 and import_rows.source_row_number/status; no unnecessary rename or data rewrite is attempted.
Replaces the Product Master no-stock gate string-format dependency with checks for preview rejection, commit-time defense in depth and the physical-stock forbidden-field allowlist.

Adds an add-only, protected, one-table-per-setup-batch HR migration for effective-dated taxable/exempt allowance split, pensionable salary and payroll statutory calculation snapshots, while retaining the 49 business-table contract.

Implements the versioned Ethiopian monthly PAYE bracket formula and 7% employee / 11% employer pension arithmetic with exact two-decimal money arithmetic, validation, an explicit full-month boundary, and no retroactive rewrite of historical payroll.

Requires an owner record for exempt allowance legal basis and for pensionable salary that differs from base salary; a separate payroll readiness gate remains red until active employees are classified.
Audits and balances payroll journal postings and separates employee pension, employer pension, income-tax and other-deduction liabilities with account-type checks.
Excludes RETAINER_SERVICE from employee statutory payroll generation and reports exclusions rather than letting one service-contract record silently contaminate or block employee payroll.
Adds reproducible 30-assertion statutory payroll calculations and HR schema/health-gate contract tests; extends the bundled local QA entry point.
Adds mobile overflow containment for System Health evidence cards and target-schema diagnostics.

Corrects the Proclamation No. 1395/2025 employment-income application date to 2025-07-08; July 2025 is held for separately approved split-period treatment, and the monthly calculator begins 2025-08-01. Historical posted payroll is not recalculated automatically.

Adds a six-module deterministic CSS source architecture with one minified local delivery bundle; modernizes the typography, color system, controls and card spacing; makes System Health title non-sticky and mobile report/import tables into labelled cards; keeps existing server-side Daily Inventory, Daily POS staging/release and Product Master no-stock workflow contracts unchanged.

Restores Reports & Analytics render path and menu visibility for report-authorized roles; no new permission is added. Report summary fails closed if a branch-scoped user has no valid assigned location.
Restores two-column dashboard layout for 992px–1399.98px desktop/laptop widths while preserving stacked tablet/mobile layouts.
Adds request-key and payload-fingerprint replay protection for purchase-order creation and goods receipts using existing notes fields and named locks; no schema expansion.
Audits PO/receipt lock boundaries against PLEDGER/GL: PO/header/item rows are locked, day/location locks are retained, and receipt replay requires an existing posted journal.

16.1.57: payroll requires Management draft preparation/submission, independent Owner approval with statutory/component evidence and balanced GL posting, then separate Owner payment; notifications follow the transitions.
